323)༄༅/sgrub pa bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa 'don bder bsdebs pa ni/na mo/dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs la/

tei:div.tei:p: sgrub pa bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa 'don bder bsdebs pa ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba sems can kun don du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng*// hūm̐ yig mthing nag yongs gyur las// bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// phyag drug rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams// dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan yum dang 'khril// spyi mgrin 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs// thugs kar rdor sems thugs ka ru// rdo rje hūm̐ dmar sngags kyis bskor// dpral bar 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gshed// mgrin par rta mgrin pad+ma dbang*// thugs kar badz+ra he ru kaḥ /lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu che// gsang bar bla med he ru kaḥ /brla g.yas dregs pa kun 'dul rje// g.yon du stobs ldan nag po la// spyi bor bla ma rig 'dzin gsal// lha tshogs kun gyi gnas gsum dang*// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: 324) oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu āḥ zhi ba spyi sngags so/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: khro bo spyi sngags so/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā kro dhi shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ hrīḥpad+man ta krita badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+naṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro dhi shwa ri s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa ka la ru pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi zab gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer mkhas grub karma chags med rin po che'i gsung la 'don bder bsdebs pa'o// pad+ma ma ṇiso// dge'o//
